quotes.text: When these systems are embedded within supply chain digital twin environments – where real-time scenario evaluation and rapid disruption response are expected – the gap between algorithmic output and human comprehension becomes a barrier to effective, accountable decision-making.

In a digital twin deployment, the framework’s three-layer architecture maps naturally onto the twin’s operational cycle. Layer 1 (optimisation) executes during the twin’s scenario evaluation phase; Layers 2 and 3 (surrogate training and semantic abstraction) pre-compute the concept-level profiles
quotes.section: 5.2 Managerial implications (The framework as a preparedness tool)

quotes.text: Finally, the case study operates on synthetic instances generated within predefined parameter ranges and a fixed network structure.
The framework is evaluated on a four-tier cereal supply chain comprising 10 suppliers (𝒮), 3 mills (𝒫), 2 transformers (𝒟), and 8 retailers (ℛ).

Layer 2 is a surrogate-based explanatory layer that trains a supervised model on the optimisation outputs and analyses it using SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) to produce feature-level attribution values.

it provides managers with structured, surrogate-derived evidence on which operational factors to monitor, which interventions may warrant prioritisation, and when algorithmic recommendations merit scrutiny rather than automatic implementation.

ft_note: Excluir: el gemelo digital es solo contexto y despliegue prospectivo (Abstract, 1, 5.1–5.2); no se implementa, simula ni diseña con componentes/flujos. Lo construido: MILP RAS, surrogates ML (RF, Extra Trees) y SHAP sobre 7.500 instancias sintéticas de cadena cerealera. Cumple criterios 2 y 3. Duda: si Rodrigo acepta el mapeo de 5.2 como diseño, sería nivel 4, HITL mantenido (interpretar/anular).
